title: Senior Backend Engineer - NestJS
shortDescription: We are looking for a skilled Backend Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will design and build scalable REST APIs, own microservice infrastructure, and collaborate with frontend and data teams to deliver high-quality product features.
fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Design and implement high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs with Node.js and NestJS
- Manage PostgreSQL schemas, query optimisation, and data migrations
- Integrate Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, and third-party services
- Define coding standards and mentor junior engineers
- Collaborate with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes)

Requirements:
- 3+ years of professional Node.js / NestJS backend experience
- Strong command of TypeScript and RESTful API design principles
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and message queues
- Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP)
- Good understanding of security best practices (OWASP Top 10)

Nice to have:
- Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems
- Knowledge of GraphQL and API gateway patterns
educationLevel: Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field
